CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs

   D. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
